## Code Review

This pull request establishes Aliyun OSS as the canonical private source-document storage provider, updating environment templates, architecture decisions, contract maps, and historical documentation overlays to reflect this policy. It also adds a test suite to validate these decisions and configurations. The review feedback suggests improving the robustness of the environment variable test by splitting the file content by lines and performing exact matches, which avoids potential cross-platform CRLF line ending failures and regex wildcard escaping issues.
